title: Identifying sensitivity-dominant parameters via active subspaces in reduced-order modeling of fluid dynamics
summary: Reduced-order models (ROMs) are widely employed to describe complex system dynamics when simulations with full-order models (FOMs) are computationally prohibitive. This study presents POD-AS-PRS, a novel model-reduction framework based on the active subspaces (AS) technique, which performs dimensionality reduction in both the state and parameter spaces, enabling efficient and high-fidelity approximations of quantities of interest (QoI).
